limitations: No audio was played, transcribed or perceptually judged in this task.

Exact cross-hero matching ignores case and punctuation. It covers 75,320 source records for 123 mapped hero identities, including persona files; it is not a proof that no similar line exists elsewhere.
Word counts split punctuation and contractions for a consistent conservative screen; they are not phonetic token counts.
Matching expected text to source metadata does not prove the hosted audio is intelligible, audible in the game time limit, or voiced by the expected speaker. The parent agent owns those checks.
Generic wording is not itself a defect in an audio-identification game. Similar opening words do not prove similar voices.

corpusReconciliation.initialSubsetExplanation: The first pass skipped files whose first record had no text and filtered response records to the 123 playable hero identities. The corrected pass loads all 226 response files, compares all nonempty text records, and retains non-hero/persona source matches separately.
